versions.changelog:
self-improvement-daemon v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Introduced a self-improvement daemon for continual learning and system optimization.
- Provides CLI and Python API for starting, stopping, and checking daemon status.
- Responds to commands related to self-improvement and system evolution.
- Tracks relevant B站 (Bilibili) learning content history and video references.
- Integrates with the "learn-expand" core management system.
- Supports event-driven triggers for usage scenarios like “自我进化” and “升级系统”.
